summary: The boss who hands you the work: {boss} is out again, and {visitor} wants a decision made in {boss}'s name.
realLife: In 1931 Congressman Richard Kleberg hired him, at 23, as his secretary. Kleberg had little interest in daily work and handed it to Johnson, who ran the office.
gates: You work on an officeholder's staff.
weights: How often {boss} is absent or uninterested.
choices: tell {visitor} you will ask and wait
send {visitor} to someone else on the staff

branches.then: {boss} finds out and tells you to stay in your lane. The tie drops and you are watched.
{boss}'s likely opponent asks you to lunch. Going is a betrayal if anyone sees.
A list of everyone you helped becomes a record your own race reads later.
